address: 3F, Regent Hotel, 3, Lane 39, Section 2, Zhongshan North Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, 104, Taiwan
bio: Featuring Chinese calligraphy on glass screens, the elegant room nods to its heritage. The menu offers classics such as Cantonese barbecue, seafood and dim sum. The seasonal dishes that showcase ingredients at their peak are highly recommended – the autumn crab feast boasts six different breeds from all over the world, in some 20 recipes ranging from cold appetisers and dim sum to hot mains.
